parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ p_lead_id: $json.lead_id, p_fields: Object.assign({ reply_detected: true, reply_text: $json.snippet, lead_status: $json.new_status }, $json.suppress ? { do_not_contact: true } : {}) }) }}
parameters.notes: Writes the classification's status and, on an unsubscribe, do_not_contact -- the flag all three send paths filter on. Before this, a reply saying STOP became lead_status 'Replied' and stayed contactable.
